card.name: Just before an official's job title
card.fires_on: Small words or name parts right before a person's job title or role at an agency or organization, such as 'a' before 'representative' or a comma after a name before 'the head of'.

modes.label: Article or comma before a role
modes.description: An 'a' or comma after an organization or person's name, just before a spokesperson or official title.
modes.example: When we asked NASA about the possibilities of a moon base,<< a>> representative wouldn’t confirm or deny the plans

modes.label: Inside agency names before staff
modes.description: Part of an agency or organization name or a modifier just before a staff role such as manager or leader.
modes.example: according to Gary Nelson, a D<<NR>> wildlife manager who spearheaded that work.

modes.label: Audience of officials
modes.description: Words like 'for' or 'agency' before a list of official personnel types.
modes.example: This foundation course is designed<< for>> government officials, trade experts, government lawyers

card.writes: It suppresses Chinese words for executive and leader titles (CEO, president, director), so it steers away from predicting a top-leader title next.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before an official's job title, such as a spokesperson at an agency.
